questions.question: Explain existential philosophy in social behaviour. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• Explain existential philosophy in social behaviour. [K] / [CO2]
  • Existential philosophy in social behaviour refers to the idea that individuals have freedom to
  • make their own choices and are responsible for their actions in society. It emphasizes that
  • human beings create their own values and meaning in life through their decisions and actions,
  • rather than simply following rules imposed by society.
